description: Best Sellers Rank (BSR) HISTORY for one Amazon ASIN — the observed rank series over time, with first/last observation dates, plus the product's identity (brand, title, price, rating, current BSR). Use when the user asks how an ASIN's rank/demand has MOVED: 'BSR history for B0…', 'is this product's rank improving', 'rank trend over the last months'. For WHO sells it over time use asin_buybox_history instead; for a live snapshot right now use collect_asin_now. Amazon marketplaces only; one ASIN per call.

marketplace_id.description: 1 = Amazon UK, 2 = Amazon US (default), 4 = Amazon CA, 5 = Amazon AU, 6 = Amazon DE, 7 = Amazon JP, 8 = Amazon IT, 9 = Amazon FR, 10 = Amazon ES, 11 = Amazon MX, 12 = Amazon BR. Amazon only.

name: asin_bsr_history
